spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.meaning: The queen sits among roses holding a pentacle, warm, practical and quietly abundant.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.meaning: Reversed, the harvest seems too slow and effort feels unrewarded; reassess the investment.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: Death
cards.meaning: Reversed, you cling to what has already died, resisting a change that would set you free.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws Queen of Pentacles (星币王后) upright, highlighting practical, motherly, down-to-earth. Present (现在) draws Seven of Pentacles (星币七) reversed, highlighting lack of long-term vision, limited reward, impatience. Future (未来) draws Death (死神) reversed, highlighting resistance to change, inability to move on, stagnation. 1 Major Arcana card(s) mark the significant, fated threads running through an otherwise everyday situation. 2 reversed card(s) point to energies that are blocked, internalised or delayed, and ask to be examined rather than forced.
